narr: An approaching cold front sparked off showers and thunderstorms across the forecast area. Flash flooding resulted.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in Sea Girt with an estimated of six inches of water on roads.
lsr: Pictures showed water over a road in Sea Girt. Estimated to be about 6 inches deep.
NJ DOT reported flooding on NJ 35 in both directions at North of NJ 71/H Street (Belmar), All lanes closed northbound; All lanes closed southbound.
